name: Long paths above the random-graph phase transition
description: construct() -> a nonempty ordered list of distinct vertices in 0..99 forming a simple path in the pinned graph; all consecutive pairs must be edges. Maximize path vertex count. No path-closing edge is required. A locally generated G(100,1.8/100) sample, using random.Random(748), is pinned. The finite path score certifies a lower bound for this one graph, without proving a high-probability asymptotic result.
